name: shellside
description: Dual-surface portfolio + dev editorial desk framework

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shellside/content-model && npm run build -w @shellside/look && npm run build -w @shellside/edit-protocol && npm run build -w @shellside/dev-api && npm run build -w @shellside/console-vfs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @shellside/content-model && npm run test -w @shellside/edit-protocol && npm run test -w @shellside/look && npm run test -w @shellside/dev-api && npm run test -w @shellside/console-vfs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test && node scripts/check-reference.mjs && npm run build:reference && node scripts/check-public-output.mjs && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
